title: NORAD tracks Santa in Christmas tradition. See the live map.
summary: NORAD, the North American Aerospace Defense Command, tracks Santa's Christmas Eve flight around the world each year. Follow a live map of the tracker here.

title: Trump plows ahead with construction plans as preservation group seeks limits
summary: President Trump has overhauled parts of the White House at a sprinter's pace with virtually no oversight, and it appears there is little standing in his way.

title: 19 states and D.C. sue HHS over effort to ban transgender care for minors
summary: The declaration issued by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services called treatments like puberty blockers, hormone therapy and surgeries unsafe and ineffective for children and adolescents experiencing gender dysphoria.

title: 2 killed, several missing after nursing home explosion in Pennsylvania
summary: Two people are dead after an explosion at a nursing home in Bristol, Pennsylvania, and several are still missing, Gov. Josh Shapiro said. CBS Philadelphia reporter Nikki DeMentri reports.

title: At least 6 people killed in crash of medical flight near Galveston, Texas
summary: A small Mexican navy plane on a medical mission crashed Monday near Galveston, Texas, killing at least six people.

title: Holiday train delivers Christmas cheer to U.S. and Canada
summary: When the Canadian Pacific Kansas City holiday train rolls into town, the tracks transform into a holiday festival. Lana Zak has the story.

title: DOJ releases huge new set of Epstein files with many mentions of Trump
summary: The Justice Department early Tuesday released more than 11,000 additional documents and photos from the Jeffrey Epstein files. Follow live updates here.

title: FDA approves weight loss drug in daily pill form
summary: Regulators at the U.S. Food and Drug Administration gave the green light to a pill version of the blockbuster weight-loss drug Wegovy, the first daily oral medication approved to treat obesity. Dr. Jon LaPook has more.

title: Mom opens up about financial strain of caring for both teen daughter and aging parent
summary: Between now and 2030, about 10,000 Americans will turn 65 every single day, giving rise to a term known as the "sandwich generation" -- adults who find themselves caring for their aging parents while still raising their own children. CBS News spoke to one woman about her struggles.

title: Bystanders pull survivors from wreckage of deadly plane crash
summary: Federal investigators are looking into what caused a deadly plane crash in Galveston Bay, off the Texas coast. A medical plane transporting a child burn victim from Mexico went down with eight people on board. Five were killed, including the 2-year-old. Karen Hua has more on the rescue mission.

title: Millions flock to airports as Christmas travel hits peak
summary: Since Friday, more than 11.1 million people have passed through TSA checkpoints at airports nationwide. Kris Van Cleave reports from Los Angeles International Airport.

title: California flooding threat grows as wildfire survivors face Christmas evacuation
summary: Residents who survived this year's devastating wildfire in Altadena, California, and are still recovering from the shock now face severe floods and another evacuation. Andres Gutierrez reports.

title: D.C. National Guard shooting suspect facing 5 additional federal charges
summary: Rahmanullah Lakanwal, a 29-year-old Afghan national, is accused of fatally shooting Army Spc. Sarah Beckstrom and wounding Air Force Staff Sgt. Andrew Wolfe.

title: Supreme Court says Trump can't deploy National Guard to Chicago for now
summary: President Trump invoked a law called Title 10 to bring members of the Illinois National Guard under federal service over the objections of state and local leaders.

title: Taylor Swift donates $1 million to Feeding America, group says
summary: Feeding America's CEO said the organization is "incredibly grateful" for Taylor Swift's large donation.

title: Former GOP Sen. Ben Sasse says he has stage-four pancreatic cancer
summary: Republican Ben Sasse represented Nebraska in the U.S. Senate from 2015 to 2023, then became president of the University of Florida.

title: Trump administration seeks to cancel thousands of asylum cases
summary: ICE has filed more than 8,000 requests to toss out asylum claims in immigration court, asking judges to send immigrants to third-party countries.

title: Flu season is ramping up, and some experts are "pretty worried"
summary: Doctors and scientists say this year's influenza season could be tougher than usual, with a new version of the flu virus, called H3N2, spreading quickly.

title: Rob and Michele Reiner's children release new statement on memorial plans
summary: The children of slain filmmaker Rob Reiner and his wife, Michele Singer Reiner, have released another statement in the wake of their parents' deaths.

title: Small plane makes emergency landing with first use of Autoland system
summary: For the first time, an automatic landing system called Autoland was used to land a plane in Colorado after pilots reported losing cabin pressure mid-flight. The safety system activated itself and took control of the aircraft to land it. Kris Van Cleave has more.

title: Did man stage a freak car accident to cover up wife's murder?
summary: The couple's children say their father is innocent and point out that he had 28 guns in the basement if he really wanted to kill her.

title: Aubrey O'Day on Sean "Diddy" Combs and her desire to help others: "Speaking for the underdogs"
summary: Singer Aubrey O'Day spoke exclusively to CBS News following the release of Netflix's documentary series, "Sean Combs: The Reckoning." In the documentary O'Day reveals that she learned about an affidavit from an unidentified witness who claims to have seen Combs and another man sexually assault her. Combs denies the allegations in the Netflix documentary and…

title: L.A. area braces for flash flooding, risk of landslides: "My biggest fear"
summary: On Monday, the mountains of northern California were hit with heavy snow following days of rainfall at lower altitudes. Now, officials in L.A. are issuing evacuation warnings for sections of the city due to potential flooding concerns. Rob Marciano reports.

title: Aubrey O'Day opens up about disturbing Sean "Diddy" Combs affidavit
summary: Aubrey O'Day discusses the disturbing witness affidavit involving Sean "Diddy" Combs in a "CBS Mornings" interview on Tuesday.

title: Powerball's Christmas Eve jackpot rises to about $1.7 billion
summary: With no winner in Monday's drawing, the Powerball jackpot on Christmas Eve will be an estimated $1.7 billion.

title: Plane makes emergency landing without pilot's help, in first use of "Autoland"
summary: On Saturday, a plane landed at Rocky Mountain Metropolitan Airport without a pilot's help.

title: Barry Manilow reveals lung cancer diagnosis, cancels concerts due to surgery
summary: The singer said an MRI showed a cancerous spot on one of his lungs after he recovered from a lengthy bout of bronchitis.
